name: Opera House
summary: The opera house is the facade you pass walking Đồng Khởi from the cathedral. The city itinerary calls it the Saigon Opera House and says Lune Production stages circus and cultural shows several nights a week, about an hour. A street number was not printed. No daytime interior hour was printed. The night is a ticket, and the nights were not listed.
timeNeeded: The facade is a stop on the walk. The show is about an hour on the city itinerary.

body: The city itinerary and the southern page put the building along Đồng Khởi from the cathedral. Visit HCMC prints about 3.1 km from the Jade Emperor Pagoda. A street number was not on the pages opened. Check on arrival.

By day the visit is the facade. At night the city itinerary says Lune Production stages circus and cultural shows several nights a week, about an hour. The station Nhà hát Thành phố is one of the three underground stations on Line 1, with Bến Thành and Ba Son, in the December 2024 opening article. The second photograph is the building from the side, in a different hour.
